SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.kind = 'class'
  AND s.is_public = false
  AND s.file_id IN (
    SELECT f.file_id
    FROM code.files f
    WHERE f.is_test = false
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c
    WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
      AND c.call_kind = 'direct'
      AND c.resolution = 'same_file'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c2
    WHERE c2.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
      AND c2.call_kind = 'direct'
      AND c2.resolution = 'same_file'
      AND c2.caller_symbol_id IN (
        SELECT s2.symbol_id
        FROM code.symbols s2
        WHERE s2.kind = 'class'
          AND s2.file_id IN (
            SELECT f2.file_id
            FROM code.files f2
            WHERE f2.is_test = true
          )
      )
  )
ORDER BY class_symbol_id

request:
Consider the agent classes defined in non-test code that directly subclass BaseAgent from auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py (every file under a tests/ folder, conftest.py and helpers included, is test code). Which of these agent classes are constructed (the class is called by name, e.g. ResponseAgent()) somewhere in non-test code but are never constructed anywhere in test code? Count only direct constructor calls written in a function or method body; patching or referencing a class without calling it does not count, and a test that calls a function which constructs the class does not count as constructing it. Return their class symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds all public classes in non-test files that have at least one direct constructor call within non-test code, then excludes any class that is also the target of a direct constructor call from a test file. This yields the agent classes that are constructed in production code but never directly constructed in test code.

FROM code.symbols s

  AND s.is_public = false
  AND s.file_id IN (
    SELECT f.file_id
    FROM code.files f
    WHERE f.is_test = false
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c
    WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
      AND c.call_kind = 'direct'
      AND c.resolution = 'same_file'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c2
    WHERE c2.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
      AND c2.call_kind = 'direct'
      AND c2.resolution = 'same_file'
      AND c2.caller_symbol_id IN (
        SELECT s2.symbol_id
        FROM code.symbols s2
        WHERE s2.kind = 'class'
          AND s2.file_id IN (
            SELECT f2.file_id
            FROM code.files f2
            WHERE f2.is_test = true
          )
      )
  )
ORDER BY class_symbol_id
